title: Ada and the Confession
author: Hazel Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Sandoval, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
